{{Quote|The Javat Caridan Environment and the Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat. It's a preserve for endangered animal species—endangered because they're from Carida and most were wiped out when that system was destroyed. Just after the Yuuzhan Vong War, one of the original Pop-Dogs, Captain Jam Javat, bought this property and turned it into a preserve.|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat''' was a wildlife refuge for endangered animal species from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] after its [[Destruction of Carida|destruction]]. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. It was established by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jam Javat]] shortly after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" />

The habitat consisted of a long [[Color/Legends|yellow]] structure surrounded by [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]] mounted on poles and a paved landing zone. It housed several animals, including [[pop-dog]]s and [[Dwarf bantha/Legends|dwarf banthas]], for children to pet.<ref name="MK" />
